review:
Big Bass with an electric twist: fisherman wilds can land on reels one and five in the base game with a random multiplier up to 10x, and wilds collect fish worth up to 500x throughout.

Three scatters trigger up to nine free spins, and if only two land, a hook can reel in a third. In the bonus, every seventh wild adds five spins and pushes the multiplier to 2x, 3x, then 10x. 96.5% RTP. Great if you want action in the base game.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
